[[Laç|Bashkia Laç]] (25%) | chrtitle = President | chairman = [[Pashk Laska]] | manager = [[Qatip Osmani]] | league = [[Kategoria Superiore]] | season = [[2025–26 Kategoria e Parë|2025–26]] | position = [[Kategoria e Parë]], 1st (champions) | website = | pattern_la1 = _blackborder | pattern_b1 = _laci2122h | pattern_ra1 = _blackborder | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = ffffff | body1 = ffffff | rightarm1 = ffffff | shorts1 = ffffff | socks1 = ffffff | pattern_la2 = _uhlsportscore26bw | pattern_b2 = _uhlsportscore26bw | pattern_ra2 = _uhlsportscore26bw | pattern_sh2 = _uhlsportscore26bw | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 000000 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | current = }} '''Klubi i Futbollit Laçi''' is an Albanian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Laç]]. The club competes in the [[Kategoria Superiore]], the first tier of [[Football in Albania|Albanian football]]. Their home ground is [[Laçi Stadium]], which has a seating capacity of 2,271. Under the ownership of local businessman and club president [[Pashk Laska]], Laçi has established itself as a top-half [[Kategoria Superiore]] side since being promoted back to the division in 2009, with their highest-ever finish coming in the [[2013–14 Kategoria Superiore]] season where they finished third. The club have also won the [[Albanian Cup]] on two occasions during this period, in [[2012–13 Albanian Cup|2013]] and [[2014–15 Albanian Cup|2015]], they have qualified for the [[UEFA Europa League|Europa League]] seven times, reaching the second qualifying round on three occasions, and they have qualified for the [[UEFA Europa Conference League|Europa Conference League]] one time, reaching the third qualifying round in 2021."}}
